name: grim-courier-crew
description: Multi-agent customs intelligence crew and mathematical 4x4 split-shipment optimizer for Ecuadorian imports, integrated with PhantasmTrack.
author: ArielSebas
highlights: Agent 1, the Tariff Inquisitor, flags ARCSA and ARCOTEL restrictions, commercial quantities and units over 4x4 limits.
Agent 2, the Split-Shipment Alchemist, packs oversized carts into 4x4 boxes with exact net USD savings, verified by fast-check property tests.
Agent 3, the Route Dispatcher, compares Temu Direct, LaarBox and Upper per box and exports manifests to PhantasmTrack.
A built-in MCP server exposes all four crew tools to any Kiro Crew agent.

crons.name: quota-mana-audit
crons.message: Audit active international shipments against the SENAE 4x4 (4kg / $400 USD) and $1,600 annual cap, and recommend split-shipment optimizations.

commands.title: Optimize SENAE 4x4 Cart Split
commands.subtitle: Run the 3-agent GrimCourier Crew on an import haul
commands.prompt: Analyze and split this international cart under Ecuador SENAE 4x4 rules: {argument}

argument.placeholder: e.g., 8 items totaling 5.8 kg and $460 USD FOB
argument.hint: Describe your international shopping cart weight and value
